t: Toupret TTHUMIB06GB Humi-Block anti-damp render is a breathable damp-proof coating for porous and untreated masonry on interior and exterior surfaces. Suitable for basements, cellars and garages, it helps control moisture while allowing walls to breathe. The water-vapour permeable formula blocks water penetration outside and forms a breathable water barrier indoors, helping reduce trapped damp in masonry. It can be applied directly to damp and raw masonry substrates with a brush or trowel, with no need to seal the surface before use. The off-white finish can also be painted once dry.
b: Controls Damp In Basements, Cellars & Garages
